name: Ferrogate School Bus
description: An armored school bus that transports children through Tier 1-3 districts to educational facilities. The armor is not decorative — school buses in GLMZ have been targeted by everyone from desperate carjackers to corporate recruiters scouting for augmentation-compatible children. The buses are old, yellow (tradition dies hard), and driven by people who are either deeply committed to protecting children or deeply committed to the hazard pay. The morning and afternoon runs are the most heavily armed convoys most Tier 1 residents will ever see that aren't military.
autonomy: Human driver, monitored route with GPS tracking and emergency alert
armament: Armor plating, anti-boarding deterrent, emergency lockdown, direct line to Ferrogate security.
common_usage: School transit, the daily miracle of getting children through dangerous districts alive.
story_hooks: A school bus driver has been taking an unauthorized detour through a condemned district every morning — picking up children who aren't enrolled anywhere
The armored school buses are the most heavily fortified vehicles in Tier 1, and someone wants to repurpose that armor for a different kind of convoy
physical_description: A battered yellow school bus, its original paint faded to the color of old bone, reinforced with welded steel plating and ballistic polymer panels that bulge awkwardly beneath the windows. Rusted bumpers frame a reinforced grille, and the familiar SCHOOL BUS lettering is scarred with impact marks. Wire cages seal the windows; a rotating spotlight and compact radar dome sit bolted to the roof beside communications antennae that angle toward the perpetually gray sky.
